NOTE
**Still not ready: no before/after screenshots and the PR isn't linked to its issue**

New: The author rebased onto main (CI is green) and says the PR addresses #37647, but the diff is the same size and nothing was added for the earlier feedback. Missing: before/after screenshots showing the spacing problem and the fix, and a "Fixes: #37647" line with how it was tested (the description says the fix came from code analysis only).

###### Next step

"not ready" stays. Nobody needs to be assigned yet. It would also help to ask how this differs from the older open PR #39267 for the same issue.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the rebase, @Shinu-Cherian. Before we can review this, please add "Fixes: #37647" to the description, along with before/after screenshots from testing the dropdown. Please also say how this differs from #39267, which targets the same issue. See the [review process guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/review-process.html).
```
